policy: docs/sdlc/CI.md section 'Dependency advisory triage'. Production advisories (moderate or higher) are never allowlisted. A critical or high advisory in development tooling needs an entry here with a reason, an owner, a remediation and an expiry; an expired entry fails the gate again.

entries.reason: Concerns the Vitest UI server listening on a port. CI and local runs use `vitest run` (no UI server, no --api flag) so the vulnerable surface is not started.
entries.remediation: Upgrade vitest to the next major (reported fix 5.0.x) in ticket SDLC-T08 and rerun the full suite; the fix is a major version change.

entries.reason: Prototype-pollution gadget through worker options passed to the pool. Options are set only by the repository's own vitest config; no untrusted input reaches the pool in CI or locally.
entries.remediation: Resolved by the same vitest major upgrade (SDLC-T08).

entries.reason: Second tinypool advisory (options to run()) with the same exposure as above: only repository-controlled test configuration reaches it.
entries.remediation: Resolved by the same vitest major upgrade (SDLC-T08).

entries.reason: Custom generators with size zero can loop. Transitive dev dependency; the repository never calls nanoid with a custom generator.
entries.remediation: A non-major fix is available (`npm audit fix`); apply it in SDLC-T08 with the lockfile diff reviewed.

entries.reason: Event-loop denial of service through crafted indexed source maps. Transitive dev dependency processing only repository-built maps.
entries.remediation: A non-major fix is available (`npm audit fix`); apply it in SDLC-T08 with the lockfile diff reviewed.

entries.reason: Vite development-server advisory (GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm). Vite is a transitive dependency of vitest; no Vite dev server is started by vitest run, and the web app is built with Astro and previewed on loopback only.
entries.remediation: Planned, not yet done: the vitest major upgrade (SDLC-T08) clears this and the vitest, tinypool and esbuild advisories; the lockfile still pins vitest 2.x and vite 5.x. Revisit before the expiry.
